parsed.visual_overview: A split-screen ad where a young woman first hooks the viewer from her car, then transitions to a home studio where she practices English with an AI robot tutor. The AI corrects her mistakes live, and the ad ends with an app store installation screen.

scenes.script_native: Neha says: Stop saying I am fine, thank you, I don't know, and you are welcome. ये बहुत basic English है। पहले मैं भी ऐसी ही English बोलती थी। फिर मैंने Supernova AI पर practice करना शुरू किया।
scenes.script_roman: Neha says: Stop saying I am fine, thank you, I don't know, and you are welcome. Ye bahut basic English hai. Pehle main bhi aisi hi English bolti thi. Phir maine Supernova AI par practice karna shuru kiya.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: What is your name?
Neha says: My name is Neha.
Miss Nova says: How old are you?
Neha says: I have 22.
Miss Nova says: I have 22, नहीं। I am 22 years old होता है।
Neha says: Okay, okay. I am 22 years old.
Miss Nova says: Where are you from?
Neha says: I am Uttar Pradesh.
Miss Nova says: I am Uttar Pradesh, नहीं। I am from Uttar Pradesh होगा।
Neha says: ठीक है, ठीक है। मुझे English अच्छे से नहीं आती।
Miss Nova says: कोई problem नहीं। मेरे जैसी AI teacher के साथ try किया?
Neha says: वो तो महंगे होते होंगे ना?
Miss Nova says: बिल्कुल नहीं। Offline classes से सात गुना सस्ता है। इसलिए 1 crore+ लोग मेरे साथ Supernova AI पर बोलने की practice कर रहे हैं।
Neha says: पर time नहीं मिलता।
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: What is your name?
Neha says: My name is Neha.
Miss Nova says: How old are you?
Neha says: I have 22.
Miss Nova says: I have 22, nahi. I am 22 years old hota hai.
Neha says: Okay, okay. I am 22 years old.
Miss Nova says: Where are you from?
Neha says: I am Uttar Pradesh.
Miss Nova says: I am Uttar Pradesh, nahi. I am from Uttar Pradesh hoga.
Neha says: Theek hai, theek hai. Mujhe English achhe se nahi aati.
Miss Nova says: Koi problem nahi. Mere jaisi AI teacher ke saath try kiya?
Neha says: Wo toh mehenge hote honge na?
Miss Nova says: Bilkul nahi. Offline classes se saat guna sasta hai. Isliye 1 crore+ log mere saath Supernova AI par bolne ki practice kar rahe hain.
Neha says: Par time nahi milta.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: रोज़ सिर्फ 10-15 minutes की practice काफी है। और मैं सब कुछ Hindi में समझाती हूँ।
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Roz sirf 10-15 minutes ki practice kaafi hai. Aur main sab kuch Hindi mein samjhati hoon.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: आप बिल्कुल confident हो जाएँगी।
Neha says: कैसे join करूँ?
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Aap bilkul confident ho jayengi.
Neha says: Kaise join karoon?

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: ये install का button दबाइए और Supernova AI app download कीजिए। सिर्फ 30 days में आपको improvement दिखने लगेगा।
Neha says: मैं तो अभी download कर रही हूँ!
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Ye install ka button dabaiye aur Supernova AI app download kijiye. Sirf 30 days mein aapko improvement dikhne lagega.
Neha says: Main toh abhi download kar rahi hoon!

pitch_points_used: Time is not the blocker (10-15 minutes a day)
